title: Italian Galette Stuffed with Cheddar and French Herbs
description: A delicious Italian-inspired galette filled with cheddar cheese and French herbs, perfect for a cozy dinner or snack.
instructions: Roll out the pizza dough to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
In a small bowl, mix together the cheddar cheese and French herbs.
Spread the cheese mixture evenly over the center of the dough, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Fold the edges of the dough up over the filling, pressing gently to seal.
If using, place the galette on top of the filling for added crunch.
Brush the dough with a little bit of water and sprinkle with salt.
Bake for 15-20 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown and the cheese is melted.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before slicing and serving.
